jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SpruceID

SpruceID is building the future of digital identity. We develop privacy-preserving, standards-based identity and credentialing solutions that put individuals in control of their information while helping governments and enterprises deliver secure, seamless digital experiences.

Our technology enables organizations to issue, manage, and verify digital credentials, making it easier for people to prove who they are and access essential services without compromising their privacy.

We work closely with public-sector partners to modernize critical identity infrastructure, bringing open standards, interoperability, and user-centered design to systems that serve millions of people.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, complex problem-solving, and customer delivery.

In this role, you'll work directly with state governments and enterprise partners to design, build, and deploy production-grade identity solutions. You'll own technical challenges from initial discovery through implementation, launch, and ongoing operations, working closely with customers and SpruceID's engineering, product, and design teams.

This isn't a traditional implementation or solutions engineering role. You'll write production code, make architectural decisions, solve challenging integration problems, and help shape how our technology is deployed in real-world environments.

You'll also serve as a trusted technical partner to customers, translating complex requirements into scalable, secure systems while helping influence the future of SpruceID's products.

This is a fully remote position based in the United States, with opportunities to collaborate directly with public-sector partners.

What You'll Do

  • Own technical delivery end to end. Lead the architecture, development, integration, and deployment of identity and credentialing solutions for government and enterprise customers.

  • Build and ship production software. Develop reliable backend services, APIs, and full-stack web and mobile applications that meet high standards for security, privacy, accessibility, and performance.

  • Work directly with customers. Partner with government stakeholders, technical teams, and delivery leads to understand business needs, navigate technical constraints, and translate requirements into working solutions.

  • Solve complex integration challenges. Connect SpruceID's technology with existing customer systems, infrastructure, and workflows, often in environments with unique operational and regulatory requirements.

  • Contribute across our technology stack. Build and maintain software across backend services, web applications, and Rust codebases, including components that run on mobile devices and in browsers.

  • Lead cross-functional execution. Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and customer delivery teams to drive technical decisions, unblock projects, and deliver successful launches.

  • Guide technical strategy. Act as a trusted advisor to partners on architecture, security, interoperability, open standards, and implementation best practices.

  • Support production deployments. Own deployment readiness, troubleshoot issues, improve operational reliability, and help customers successfully adopt and operate our solutions.

  • Shape the product. Bring insights from real customer deployments back to the engineering and product teams, helping improve the scalability, usability, and maintainability of our platform.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of designing, building, and shipping production systems.

  • Strong backend engineering experience in one or more statically typed languages such as Rust, Go, Java, or C#.

  • Experience building modern web applications, with an understanding of frontend frameworks, APIs, accessibility, and application security.

  • Demonstrated ability to own complex technical projects from architecture through production deployment.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, along with modern DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure practices.

  • Experience designing integrations and working with APIs, distributed systems, and existing enterprise infrastructure.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both engineering teams and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Comfort working directly with customers, navigating ambiguity, and balancing technical tradeoffs against real-world delivery needs.

  • A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset. You enjoy building things, solving problems, and seeing your work make it into production.

  • Based in the United States and willing to travel occasionally to collaborate with government and enterprise partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with digital identity technologies, verifiable credentials, digital wallets, decentralized identifiers, or related open standards.

  • Familiarity with cryptography, authentication, authorization, privacy engineering, or secure credential exchange.

  • Experience with Rust or an interest in working extensively with Rust-based systems.

  • Previous experience delivering software for state or federal government agencies.

  • Experience navigating public-sector security, compliance, accessibility, or procurement requirements.

  • Background in forward deployed engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or customer-facing software delivery.

Why SpruceID?

At SpruceID, you'll work on technically challenging problems with meaningful real-world impact. Our team is helping build the infrastructure that will define how people prove and manage their identity in an increasingly digital world.

You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership, work directly with customers tackling important challenges, and shape both our products and how they're deployed at scale.

We value engineers who combine technical depth with curiosity, collaboration, and a bias toward shipping.

Equal Opportunity

SpruceID is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
SpruceID builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with public-sector organizations to modernize how identity is issued, verified, and used.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of technical leadership and strategic delivery. You will lead high-impact engagements with state governments and public sector partners, guiding both the architecture and the adoption strategy for digital identity solutions. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, delivery managers, and executives, both within SpruceID and on the customer side, to ensure that deployments not only succeed technically, but also achieve lasting policy and operational outcomes.

This role is hands-on and customer-facing. You’ll write and review code, architect systems, and set engineering best practices, while also shaping roadmaps, influencing standards, and representing SpruceID in strategic conversations.

This job is fully remote within the US.

What You'll Do

  • Define technical strategy and architecture for public sector deployments, ensuring both technical excellence and alignment with policy and operational needs

  • Act as the senior technical representative in executive-level customer meetings, bridging the gap between technical details and business or policy outcomes

  • Lead multiple end-to-end multi-year projects from rapid prototyping to development to operations and maintenance

  • Architect and build backend systems, full-stack web applications, and mobile solutions with a focus on security, privacy, and accessibility

  • Translate government requirements into robust, standards-based solutions that integrate with both modern and legacy systems

  • Mentor and guide forward deployed engineers and delivery teams, setting standards for high-quality engineering and customer collaboration

  • Identify and drive efficiencies across projects, ensuring knowledge and tooling are shared across teams

  • Collaborate with platform teams to feed customer insights into SpruceID’s roadmap and contributions to global identity standards

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and delivering production-grade software in statically typed languages (Rust, Go, Java, C#)

  • Proven ability to lead large-scale engineering efforts that span multiple teams and organizations

  • Strong expertise across the software development stack, including infrastructure, devops, architecture, frontend, and mobile

  • Demonstrated experience working with public sector or highly regulated industries, including direct customer engagement at both executive and technical levels

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and consulting skills with the ability to influence strategy as well as execution

  • Based in the US and willing to travel as needed to support state government partners

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience leading digital transformation or modernization efforts in the public sector

  • Familiarity with procurement, compliance, and governance considerations in state government projects

  • Deep knowledge of digital identity, computer security, cryptography, and user data privacy practices

  • Experience as a Field CTO or similar

At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer – Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
SpruceID builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with public-sector organizations to modernize how identity is issued, verified, and used.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our forward-deployed engineering team. You’ll work directly with state governments and public sector partners, and enterprise clients to design, build, and deploy impactful identity solutions. This role blends hands-on software development, technical consulting, and customer success: ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and mission-driven impact.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy full-stack solutions for state governments and public sector partners.

  • Collaborate with customer delivery leads, engineers, and UX designers to ensure successful deployments.

  • Translate customer requirements into technical architectures and production-ready systems.

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor for partners adopting open identity standards and privacy best practices.

  • Build backend services and full-stack web or mobile apps that meet public sector security, privacy, and accessibility standards.

  • Contribute to Rust codebases that run across backend, mobile, and browser environments.

  • Manage customer deployments and provide post-launch technical support.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience building backend systems in statically typed languages (Rust, Go, C#, or Java).

  • Strong background in modern web frontends (React, TypeScript, or similar) with an eye for accessibility and security.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional engineering efforts and deliver production-grade systems.

  • Strong appreciation for open-source software, standards-based design, and community-driven development.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices.

  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with customers or stakeholders.

  • Based in the U.S., excited to collaborate with state government partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with digital identity, cryptography, data privacy, or blockchain technologies (e.g., Verifiable Credentials, Decentralized Identifiers, OAuth, OpenID Connect).

  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, GraphQL, or RESTful API design and development.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automation using Terraform, or similar tools.

  • Exposure to mobile app development (React Native, Flutter, or similar frameworks).

  • Experience in security engineering, access control, federated identity, or PKI systems.

  • Prior work in public sector, government technology, or other high-compliance environments.

  • Interest in usability, accessibility (WCAG, Section 508), and inclusive product design.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or participation in digital identity standards bodies (W3C, DIF, IETF) is a plus.

At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (New Grad) – Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SpruceID

SpruceID builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with public-sector organizations to modernize how identity is issued, verified, and used.

The Opportunity

We're looking for multiple Full-Stack Engineers to join our forward-deployed engineering team. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and directly with state governments, public sector partners, and enterprise clients to help design, build, and deploy impactful identity solutions.

This is an ideal role for a recent graduate who wants to grow quickly while working on technology that matters. You'll gain hands-on experience across the full stack, learn from senior engineers, and contribute to systems that serve millions of people.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with customer delivery leads, engineers, and UX designers on real-world deployments.

  • Build full-stack features for state governments and public sector partners, with guidance from senior engineers.

  • Learn to translate customer requirements into technical solutions and production-ready systems.

  • Develop backend services and web applications that meet public sector security, privacy, and accessibility standards.

  • Contribute to codebases spanning backend, mobile, and browser environments.

  • Participate in customer deployments and learn the full lifecycle of software delivery.

  • Engage with open identity standards and privacy-focused engineering practices.

Our Commitment to Your Growth

We believe in investing in early-career engineers. As a new grad at SpruceID, you'll receive:

  • Dedicated mentorship from senior engineers who will guide your technical development.

  • Structured onboarding to get you up to speed on our stack, our standards, and our customers.

  • Regular 1:1s and feedback to help you set and achieve career goals.

  • Opportunities to own projects as you grow, with appropriate support and guardrails.

  • Exposure to the full product lifecycle—from customer discovery to production deployment.

We're not looking for someone who already knows everything. We're looking for someone eager to learn, humble enough to ask questions, and motivated to do meaningful work.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (recent graduates welcome).

  • Foundational experience with backend development in a statically typed language (Rust, Go, C#, Java, or similar)—coursework, internships, or personal projects count.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and work collaboratively.

  • Strong communication skills and genuine interest in working with customers and stakeholders.

  • Appreciation for open-source software, clean code, and thoughtful engineering.

  • Based in the U.S. (or willing to relocate without visa assistance - TN considered) and excited to contribute to impactful public sector work.

Nice to Have

  • Internship or project experience in full-stack development.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) through coursework or side projects.

  • Interest in digital identity, cryptography, data privacy, or security.

  • Familiarity with modern web frontends (React, TypeScript, or similar).

  • Familiarity with databases (PostgreSQL), APIs (REST or GraphQL), or CI/CD concepts.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or hackathon participation.

  • Coursework or interest in accessibility, usability, or inclusive design.

  • Any exposure to government technology, civic tech, or high-compliance environments.

Why SpruceID?

  • Mission-driven work: Build technology that protects privacy and improves how governments serve citizens

  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a team that values async collaboration

  • Early responsibility: We're a growing company where you'll have real impact from day one

  • Standards-based engineering: Contribute to open-source projects and work with emerging identity standards (W3C, DIF, IETF)

  • Supportive team: Join a group of engineers who care about craft, mentorship, and doing things right

At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SpruceID

SpruceID builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with public-sector organizations to modernize how identity is issued, verified, and used.

About the Role

As a Staff Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering SpruceID's digital identity solutions to our customers and partners. You will lead medium- to large-scale technical projects, working closely with internal engineering teams and external stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and delivery.

This role combines hands-on software engineering, technical project leadership, and stakeholder collaboration. You'll work directly with customers to understand their requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and coordinate across teams to drive projects forward.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, experience independently leading complex engineering projects, and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of technical outcomes. Experience with digital identity, security, privacy, and credentialing technologies is highly valuable.

This job is fully remote within the US.

What You'll Do

  • Lead medium- to large-scale software engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical planning through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand requirements, align priorities, manage expectations, and ensure successful project delivery.

  • Own technical design and implementation decisions, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with customer needs.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and delivery teams to coordinate dependencies, resolve blockers, and deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Serve as a key technical point of contact for customers and partners, communicating project progress, technical decisions, risks, and recommendations.

  • Architect, develop, and maintain backend systems, full-stack web applications, and integrations supporting SpruceID's digital identity solutions.

  • Translate complex customer requirements into clear technical specifications and actionable implementation plans.

  • Proactively identify technical risks, project dependencies, and opportunities to improve delivery efficiency.

  • Support integrations with customer infrastructure, third-party services, and legacy systems.

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and engineering best practices.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.

  • Partner with internal teams to share customer feedback and contribute to product and platform improvements.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Proven experience independently leading medium- to large-scale engineering projects, coordinating multiple teams and driving technical initiatives from planning through delivery.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Forward Deployed Product Manager

Location: U.S. (Remote, but must be based in the United States)

Travel: Depending on the assigned engagement, substantial travel to state government partner sites may be expected

Clearance: Must be eligible and able to pass a government background check

ABOUT SPRUCE

Our mission is to let users control their data across the web. We build privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing systems that help governments and institutions increase access to important services and benefits programs while reducing fraud. We believe the right approach to product management is critical to combining high standards of usability, security, and privacy into a seamless user experience and driving broad adoption.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Product Manager to sit alongside our government customers during discovery, architecture, and design, sometimes while engineering is building, and help them work out what they actually need and why.

You will support specific deployments, from statewide identity programs to large-scale education and workforce credentialing initiatives. Each must be localized to its own ecosystem: stakeholders, user demographics, regulations, and program objectives. Even as we sell a product to a customer, we treat the overall program as a product with its own governance, roadmap, and objectives. Much of this work is customer-driven today and requires hands-on engagement with individual implementations, even as we work to consolidate what we learn into reusable Spruce products. Holding both at once is the job.

A credential is only useful if someone issues it, someone accepts it, and someone carries it. So beyond discovery, you own adoption for your program: getting issuers to issue, verifiers to verify, and end users to adopt, with startup-style resourcefulness and measurable KPIs. In some cases, you will source and build the first pilot group yourself.

The surface area is broad, and you should be good at taming unknowns and complexity. One week you may be shaping the roadmap for a statewide digital identity wallet, the next a citizen-facing portal, the next the APIs and microservices underneath. You are responsible for the end-to-end product picture, how those pieces fit together, and ultimately outcomes for our customers’ customers.

This is not a roadmap-and-quarterly-planning role. We move quickly, put work in front of small pilot groups, and let evidence change the plan. At the same time, this is identity infrastructure, where security, accessibility, and reliability matter. Knowing what can be iterated on quickly and what absolutely cannot is central to doing this job well.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. CUSTOMER-EMBEDDED DISCOVERY

  • Work directly with state government partners through discovery, architecture, and design

  • Understand their users, policy environment, constraints, and workflows first-hand

  • Look past stated requirements to the underlying problem the customer is actually trying to solve

  • Navigate government relationships thoughtfully: introduce user evidence that may challenge stated priorities, and influence direction without damaging the relationship

2. END-TO-END PRODUCT OWNERSHIP

  • Hold the full product picture across user-facing experiences and the APIs and services beneath them, often across several interconnected initiatives at once

  • Help partners shape and sequence their roadmap, and make sure what gets built solves the real problem

  • Partner closely with engineering, design, and delivery leads from definition through deployment

3. HANDS-ON USER RESEARCH

  • Personally design and run research: talk to stakeholders and end users directly, run discovery, prototype where appropriate

  • Synthesize what you learn into product decisions and roadmap direction

  • Bring user evidence into conversations where requirements are often treated as fixed

There is no research team or technical product manager counterpart behind this role. You do this work yourself, whether that means digging into agency rules, legislation, user interviews, or codebases.

4. ECOSYSTEM BUILDING AND ADOPTION

  • Drive adoption of digital credentials across your program’s ecosystem: onboard issuers, verifiers, and institutional partners with startup GTM resourcefulness

  • Find high-leverage partnerships (university research programs, workforce boards, employer networks) that multiply impact beyond your own direct effort

  • Own adoption KPIs and find creative, resourceful ways to move them

5. JUDGMENT ABOUT PACE VERSUS RISK

  • Put work in front of small pilot groups early and let findings redirect the roadmap

  • Draw clear lines around what cannot be iterated on loosely: security, accessibility, and reliability

  • Make and defend those calls with engineering and with customers

Where this role ends. This is a forward-deployed role, not a core product role: you own outcomes for your engagements, not Spruce’s product-line roadmap. But you are the person closest to the field, so we expect you to notice when a problem extends beyond a single agency and flag what should become reusable Spruce capability.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 6–10+ years of product experience at startups or on new product initiatives. Former founder or founding-team operator is the ideal profile

  • Zero-to-one experience: you have taken a product from nothing to shipped, or identified and pursued entirely new opportunities

  • Meaningful experience in education, workforce development, or adjacent sectors

  • A real interest in workforce development and expanding opportunity through technology

  • Experience in government or another highly regulated environment

  • Customer-embedded experience: forward-deployed product, solutions PM, implementation, or founder-led delivery all count

  • Hands-on user research: you have designed and run discovery yourself and turned it into product decisions

  • Enough technical depth to read a codebase, hold your own with engineers on APIs, services, and system design, and make tradeoffs they respect. You do not need to be an engineer

  • Credible at the executive level: comfortable holding a room with agency directors, university chancellors, and institutional partners

  • Based in the U.S. and excited to engage directly with state government partners

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in digital identity, IAM/ICAM, credentialing, or authentication systems

  • Experience building or growing multi-sided ecosystems, marketplaces, or platform adoption

  • Background in education technology or learning and employment records

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, FedRAMP, or NIST frameworks

  • Experience navigating public sector procurement and contracting

  • Prior engineering or deeply technical systems experience

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

  • Shape identity and credentialing systems that millions of residents will actually use

  • Work directly with senior government stakeholders on mission-critical infrastructure

  • Operate at the intersection of policy, engineering, research, and real-world delivery

  • Help build the education and workforce credential ecosystems that connect people to opportunity

  • Help turn individual state deployments into durable product capability

  • Join a small, high-trust team where autonomy and judgment matter

At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Forward-Deployed Engineer (Mobile)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SpruceID

SpruceID builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with public-sector organizations, including the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), to modernize how identity is issued, stored, presented, and verified.

We're looking for a Senior or Staff Forward-Deployed Engineer to help build and scale the next generation of digital identity experiences. You'll play a key technical role in developing secure, intuitive mobile applications and SDKs that enable people to use digital credentials in everyday interactions.

This role combines deep mobile engineering expertise, security-conscious architecture, and hands-on collaboration with government partners. You'll work at the intersection of mobile platforms, cryptography, open standards, and real-world deployments, helping deliver digital identity infrastructure that can serve millions of people.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade mobile applications for digital identity and credentialing, with a particular focus on initiatives supporting the government partners.

  • Lead the development of secure digital identity wallets that enable individuals to receive, store, manage, and present digital credentials.

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and/or Android applications, with a strong emphasis on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, security, and user experience.

  • Architect and implement mobile features involving secure credential storage, device authentication, biometric authentication, cryptographic operations, and privacy-preserving data exchange.

  • Integrate emerging identity standards into mobile applications and SDKs.

  • Work with engineers, designers, product teams, and government partners to translate complex requirements into elegant, accessible mobile experiences.

  • Build and maintain mobile integrations with backend APIs, identity issuance systems, credential verification services, and platform security features.

  • Contribute to Rust-based shared libraries and cross-platform components that support secure identity functionality across mobile, backend, and browser environments.

  • Own the mobile engineering lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through testing, release management, production monitoring, and ongoing improvements.

  • Help establish mobile engineering best practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, secure development, and application performance optimization.

  • For Staff-level candidates, provide technical leadership across projects, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and help define the long-term direction of SpruceID's mobile identity platform.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building and shipping production mobile applications. Staff-level candidates should bring additional experience leading mobile architecture and major technical initiatives.

  • Deep expertise in native iOS development (Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit) and/or native Android development (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK).

  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, platform security, application lifecycle management, concurrency, performance, and reliability.

  • Experience working with mobile security capabilities such as iOS Keychain, Secure Enclave, Android Keystore, hardware-backed key storage, or biometric authentication.

  • Demonstrated ability to design and deliver complex, user-facing mobile applications from initial architecture through production deployment.

  • Experience integrating mobile applications with backend services, APIs, and authentication systems.

  • Familiarity with secure software development practices, cryptographic concepts, and protecting sensitive user information.

  • Strong engineering judgment, ability to navigate ambiguity, and experience collaborating across engineering, product, design, and external stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and architectural decisions to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Appreciation for open-source software, open standards, interoperability, and privacy-first product design.

  • Based in the United States (remote) and excited to work on digital identity infrastructure with public-sector partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing mobile driver's licenses (mDLs), digital identity wallets, verifiable credential applications, or digital document solutions.

  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 18013-5, ISO/IEC 18013-7, W3C Verifiable Credentials, OpenID4VCI, OpenID4VP, or related digital identity standards.

  • Experience implementing NFC, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), QR code, or proximity-based credential exchange protocols.

  • Understanding of public key cryptography, PKI, certificate validation, digital signatures, key management, and device attestation.

  • Experience integrating Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, or other platform-level digital credential capabilities.

  • Familiarity with Rust, including integrating shared Rust libraries into native mobile applications through FFI or other cross-language bindings.

  • Experience with cross-platform mobile development using React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, or similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, passkeys, WebAuthn, or federated identity systems.

  • Experience designing mobile SDKs or reusable libraries consumed by other engineering teams or external partners.

  • Experience with App Store and Google Play release management, mobile CI/CD, automated testing, crash reporting, and production observability.

  • Familiarity with accessibility best practices, including WCAG, Section 508, VoiceOver, and TalkBack.

  • Prior experience working in government technology, regulated industries, financial services, or other security-sensitive environments.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or participation in digital identity standards communities such as W3C, OpenID Foundation, IETF, or ISO.

Why SpruceID

At SpruceID, you'll have the opportunity to work on identity technology with tangible, large-scale public impact. You'll help shape how people securely use government-issued digital credentials while advancing an open, interoperable, and privacy-preserving approach to digital identity.

You'll work with a collaborative team tackling challenging problems across mobile platforms, applied cryptography, open standards, and government technology — with meaningful ownership over both architecture and product outcomes.

Equal Opportunity

At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.
